all_quick_tuner_timings.justification: Aggressively slash scheduling latencies and disable deep C-states while pushing cores to max perf to probe whether the workload is scheduler-latency-bound rather than I/O or DVFS-bound; this large swing keeps exploration wide yet stays safe.

all_quick_tuner_timings.justification: The best-so-far (1.16 ms) was obtained with short CFS slices and POLL-only C-states, but the next point slightly relaxed these extremes and still landed at 1.25 ms. To keep exploring without abandoning the low-latency region, nudge min_granularity even lower (500 k) and latency_ns to 10 ms while testing a milder power-saving C-state (C1E) and moderate busy-poll. This probes whether we can shave another ~0.1 ms without sacrificing robustness.

all_quick_tuner_timings.justification: The best result (1.16) came from short latency/min_granularity with POLL+max perf. This config tightens min_granularity slightly more aggressively (2M vs 1M), keeps latency_ns in the low range (8M), and pushes busy_poll higher (75) while dropping C-state to C1 instead of POLL to test if we can retain the ultra-low tail without the strictest power policy. This probes a new point in the low-latency region while remaining safe.

all_quick_tuner_timings.justification: The best point so-far (iter-3: 1.16 ms) sits at POLL+C1-low-latency settings, but the nearby iter-9 (2.09 ms) showed C1 alone plus higher busy-poll hurt. To keep exploring while staying in the low-latency region we now test the compromise C-state C1E (lighter than C1, deeper than POLL) with slightly relaxed latency_ns (15 ms vs iter-3’s 12 ms) and moderate busy-poll (30) to probe if a gentler power state plus tuned scheduler latency can beat the current best.

all_quick_tuner_timings.justification: The global best (1.16 ms) came from short latency_ns (12 ms) + very small min_granularity (1 ms) + POLL + napi_busy_poll=50.  Iter 24 already dropped min_granularity to 750 k and kept everything else aggressive, giving 2.01 ms.  I now push min_granularity even lower (800 k), latency_ns down to 4 ms, raise napi_busy_poll to 60, and slightly reduce migration_cost to 80 k.  This probes a tighter, more aggressive variant of the best-known region while staying well within safe bounds and continuing exploration rather than premature convergence.
